app.title: PDF TOOLS
app.description: PDF tools for processing documents locally.
app.metaDescription: Merge, convert, clean, extract, delete, reorder, compress, and rotate PDFs locally.
app.privacy: Temporary files are deleted after each operation.

exportOptions.saveLocationHint: When you start the export, choose a location in the Save As dialog. If it is unavailable, the standard browser download is used.
exportOptions.invalidName: Enter a valid filename without a path or prohibited characters.
exportOptions.savePickerFailed: Could not open the Save As dialog.
exportOptions.saveFailed: Could not save the file to the selected location.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine multiple PDF documents in the order you choose.

extract.title: Extract pages
extract.description: Keep only the pages you need.

delete.title: Delete pages
delete.description: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF document.

reorder.title: Reorder pages
reorder.description: Drag the thumbnails to change the order of the pages.

compress.title: Compress a PDF
compress.description: Optimize your PDF structure without reducing the quality of its content.

clean.title: Clean a PDF
clean.description: Remove metadata and annotations from your PDF.

metadata.title: Edit PDF metadata
metadata.description: Edit your PDF document’s title, author, subject and keywords.

comments.title: Comment on a PDF
comments.description: Click a page to place a comment note at that location.

protect.title: Protect a PDF
protect.description: Encrypt a PDF or change its open password using the owner password.

rotate.title: Rotate pages
rotate.description: Rotate pages and preview the result before export.

imagesToPdf.title: Convert images to PDF
imagesToPdf.description: Combine your PNG or JPEG images into a PDF in the order you choose.

pdfToImages.title: Convert a PDF to images
pdfToImages.description: Export every page as PNG or JPEG in a ZIP archive.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose normal or demo mode to preload the sample PDF.

demo.title: Operating mode
demo.hint: The anonymized PDF is preloaded in tabs that accept a PDF. Normal actions stay local; depending on the tool, processing uses the local backend or the browser. The mode resets to normal when the app closes. In demo mode, Merge receives two copies of the PDF.
demo.loadError: Could not load the demo PDF.

metadata.subject: Subject
